# Current File is a native tree view: records whose links name the file (ADRs and decisions first),…

Current File is a native tree view: records whose links name the file (ADRs and decisions first), the Agent Change Graph's rows for it, and the document sections read from it; refreshed on editor change and save

A tree view, not a webview (VS Code's native-first guideline): three groups, each item opening the record, the review queue, or the new panel's Docs. With it, a gate approval now needs every version of its record to be the user's and status done (second automated security review: an agent could have edited a user's record into an approval).
